units.rawText: From steel planes to biplanes, then to monoplanes, jetliners, and UAVs... Airplanes were first invented to carry humanity's dream of flight, to "soar through the sky freely as birds".

units.rawText: But nowadays, aircraft can pretty much fly independently without a pilot. Even when a pilot is necessary, the job has been gradually delegated to Dolls instead...

units.rawText: So haven't humans lost sight of their original goal and purpose of inventing planes in the first place?
